summary: A trusted-by row: a heading over named customer logos that people can move along.
intent: Block: a social proof row. A short heading over a row of customer logos on a kit Conveyor. Each logo is named for screen readers. The row moves only when the person moves it (arrows, arrow keys, swipe); there is no autoplay to pause.
useWhen: a trusted-by row on a landing or pricing page
a row of partner or integration marks under a hero
more logos than fit the width, moved along by the person
doNotUseWhen: quotes or case studies — a Card per testimonial
a self-scrolling marquee — not in the kit (Conveyor has no loop or autoplay)

logos.note: { id?, name, src?, logo?, href? }[]. name is required: the image's alt or the node's accessible name. src for an image, logo for a node (an inline SVG in currentColor); with neither, the name shows as text.

label.note: Names the Conveyor group and its arrows (Scroll customer logos right); the list says the count.

align.note: Heading and row alignment while the row fits.

layout: heading over one row of logos, all at the --space-8 height, --grid-gutter-xl apart
the row is as wide as its logos and centred while it fits; wider, the Conveyor shows arrows, and below --grid-breakpoint-sm of its own width it gives way to swipe
the block is its own inline-size container

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the logos are a list named with its count (Customer logos, 8) inside the Conveyor group
every logo has a name: img alt, or role=img with aria-label around a node
a logo with href is a link named by the logo, with the kit focus ring
the run is a focus stop; arrow keys and the Conveyor's ghost arrow buttons move it
nothing moves on its own, so there is nothing to pause (WCAG 2.2.2); smooth scrolling is off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not build a local marquee or auto-scrolling logo row
Do not ship a logo without a name, or with a name like logo-3
Do not use real brands in samples; use neutral placeholder marks
Do not colour logos with raw hex; inline marks use currentColor
Do not nest the strip in another Conveyor
snippet: <LogoStrip title="Trusted by teams at" logos={[{ name: 'Northpeak', src: '/logos/northpeak.svg' }, { name: 'Fieldstone', logo: <FieldstoneMark /> }]} />
